text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There are three racers getting a lot of attention in this year's Classic Triple Crown tour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide, Narita Taishin, and Winning Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As they've been rivals since before their debuts, people have given them a special nickname.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: So it's finally time for BNW's first Triple Crown showdown! I wonder who's gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: It's gotta be Taishin. Her final sprint last time was amazing.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Didn't you see Biwa Hayahide in the junior races? The way she accelerates from the get-go is something else!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: But you gotta admit Winning Ticket is great too. Her power in the final stretch is the best.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While the expectations for their match are running high, the racers themselves are quietly making their way through the tunnel entrance.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ALL RIGHT! I'm gonna go all out!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'll be the one to break ahead and win!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I've calculated my formula to win. All that's left is to get the final result.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: (I gotta win this and prove myself ahead of the Derby!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: (But then again, that goes for Taishin and Hayahide too!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wooo! I'll see you two later!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket dashes off toward the track, where the crowd is abuzz with high expectations.
